coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed, air conditioner on low for comfortable overnight temperature
Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and using the toilet
Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
Setting up the home workstation on the computer, checking phone messages, and reviewing the day's telehealth appointment list
Working from home as a health care professional, conducting telehealth consultations and updating patient records on the computer
Preparing a quick lunch with the induction cooker and eating at the kitchen counter
Taking a break, resting on the sofa and reading public-health updates on the phone
Continuing work-from-home telehealth sessions and following up on patient care plans via the computer
Freshening up after the workday, loading and starting the washing machine with used clothes
Tidying up and vacuuming the living room floor
Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and range hood, then eating the meal
Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher, and wiping down the countertops
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and browsing the phone
Taking a warm shower and hanging clothes in the dryer
Winding down in bed, turning on the desk lamp and reading, dimming the light and switching on the fan for air circulation
Sleeping, with the air conditioner set to a comfortable overnight temperature
